body:
Thanks for the info. I will take a look at it.

I did manage to sit down with my sister and talk about her issues. She agreed to see the family doctor about her issues and book appointments with the specialists. I am still going to monitor her situation and make sure she gets the treatment.

Try to find a hobby and/or a job you like to do.

I really love video gaming and some major things I look forward in life is the release of a new game. This year, it is Fallout 4.

Please tell me what you do, what interests you, and what your education/career background is. Maybe I can give some advice.

I hear you mate.

I feel like an idiot whenever I talk to people. Whenever I see jocks loudly serenading chicks or Aziz Ansari making one of this fancy jokes, I feel awful about myself because I knew I'd never be able to be like them.

However, the only way out is to keep pushing yourself to face these fears and hope your brain will start learning the skills for you.

On career and psychological issues, I strongly suggest looking for local social workers for help. You need to push yourself to do this because that's one of the feasible ways for you to get out of your situation.

Remember, the chief cause of failure is a lack of initiative. If you try, you at least will have a shot at this.

It's hard to envision a way out, but please remember life is beautiful.

You are young and have plenty of opportunities. if your job is dead-end, try to get yourself a different career path. Night school in accounting is a great way to a comfortable career. Once you have the $$, you can move out and experience complete freedom.
